# FAA Aircraft Registration and Airmen Services

> The Federal Aviation Administration's official civil aviation registry for aircraft registration, airmen certification, and pilot credential verification.

This FAA service provides public access to aircraft registration records and airmen certification databases. It serves as the authoritative source for verifying pilot licenses, airmen credentials, and aircraft ownership information within the U.S. civil aviation system.

## Key Topics

- FAA (Federal Aviation Administration)
- Aircraft Registration
- Airmen Certification
- Civil Aviation Registry
- Pilot Licensing
- Airmen Inquiry
- Airmen Services
- Aviation Records
- Name Search
- Certification Lookup
- FAA Database
- Government Portal
- Account Management
- U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT)

## Core Registry Services

- [FAA Aircraft Registration](https://amsrvs.registry.faa.gov): FAA Civil Aviation Registry homepage for aircraft registration and airmen certification
- [Airmen Inquiry - Name Search](https://amsrvs.registry.faa.gov/airmeninquiry): FAA airmen registry name search and pilot certification lookup tool
- [Airmen Services Portal](https://amsrvs.registry.faa.gov/amsrvs): FAA Airmen Services portal for certification, login, and account management

## Account Support

- [Password Recovery](https://amsrvs.registry.faa.gov/amsrvs/Account/PasswordRecover): FAA Airmen Services password recovery and account access assistance

## Optional

- [Unhandled Error](https://amsrvs.registry.faa.gov/airmeninquiry/LastResort.aspx): Error page for unhandled exceptions in FAA airmen inquiry system
